title: 3.3.6c Lab — Write a 3D property via method
description: Add a setColor(c) method to Planet that sets this.shape.color, then call it from setup().

steps.title: Add setColor(c) to Planet
steps.instructions: Inside the Planet class body, write a method `setColor(c)` that sets `this.shape.color = c`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the color property on shapes.

steps.title: Call p.setColor() in setup()
steps.instructions: After creating the instance, call `p.setColor('tomato')` (or any CSS color) in setup().
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review how methods are called on instances.

requirements.title: setColor method sets this.shape.color
requirements.description: Write a setColor(c) method inside Planet that does `this.shape.color = c`.

requirements.title: setColor() is called on the instance
requirements.description: Call p.setColor(...) somewhere in the sketch.
